ner1.text: Nerkeli: So what is it you're actually after in all these exhibits, Nuvilo? You've been wandering the fair since this morning.

nuv1.text: Nuvilo: Inspiration, mostly. I'm hoping something in these exhibits sparks the next thing I write - a building style, a landscape, some old artifact nobody's looked at twice in years.

ner2.text: Nerkeli: Careful, half of what's on display I still don't understand myself. You seen the tech wing? Little glowing block contraptions everywhere - codigos, they call them. I fly planes, I don't build them.

nuv2.text: Nuvilo: Codigos I actually know something about - the records tie the whole business to Era del Daax, when Gorff's new government first started using them. That symbol you'll have seen around got carved into old ruins right around those same years.

ner3.text: Nerkeli: Now that one I do know! The Daax symbol - peace and technology, wasn't it. I've got my own theory nobody takes seriously: ducks. I'm convinced they're the last living descendants of whatever the Daax actually was.

ner4.text: Nerkeli: Think about it! Old symbol, strange creature, nobody's ever actually explained the connection - I'm just filling the gap history left open. Somebody has to.

nuv4.text: Nuvilo: I can't argue you out of that one either way, which I suppose is exactly your point.

ner5.text: Nerkeli: Exactly my point. So - anything caught your eye yet, scholar?

nuv5.text: Nuvilo: The routes exhibit, actually. M9 runs Nvhi to Khan Ice - matters more to me than most, since my family's line traces back to Navalius, who's said to have founded Nvhi, generations back.

ner6.text: Nerkeli: Wait - Nvhi? I fly the M7 corridor half the season, Puente Intercontinental all the way up to Nvhi's edge. Never once thought about who started the place. Small world, milkantis.

nuv6.text: Nuvilo: Smaller than either of us probably realizes. Though I know less about Nvhi itself than you'd expect from someone descended from its founder - the family kept the name, not the history.

ner7.text: Nerkeli: That's family for you. Stay a while - I'll show you the plane inside, you can tell me if any of it's older than it looks.

nuv7.text: Nuvilo: I might take you up on that. Good to see you again, Nerkeli - properly, and not just passing through.

ner8.text: Nerkeli: You too. Don't let the scholars keep you all fair - some of us still remember when you couldn't tell a code block from a cobblestone.
